# Grokipedia

> > A comprehensive reference encyclopedia covering firearms and ammunition specifications, music history and discography, mythology and linguistic reconstruction, chemistry, astronomy, and film.

Grokipedia provides detailed reference articles spanning diverse topics including rimfire cartridge specifications (.22 caliber ammunition), Proto-Indo-European mythology and deity reconstructions, alternative rock band histories, and technical specifications across multiple domains. The site serves as a knowledge resource with emphasis on firearms, music, and comparative mythology.

## Key Topics

- .22 Long Rifle
- rimfire cartridges
- Proto-Indo-European mythology
- *Dyēus (sky father deity)
- linguistic reconstruction
- alternative rock bands
- Billboard charts
- firearms and ammunition history
- comparative mythology
- plinking and target shooting
- .22 caliber firearms
- band discography
- soul and jazz standards
- organosilicon compounds
- near-Earth asteroids

## Firearms & Ammunition Reference

- [.22 caliber](https://grokipedia.com/page/.22_caliber): Reference on .22 caliber firearms & .22 LR rimfire cartridge specs
- [.32 Long Colt](https://grokipedia.com/page/.32_Long_Colt): Obsolete Colt handgun cartridge from 1875 for pocket revolvers
- [.22 Winchester Automatic](https://grokipedia.com/page/.22_Winchester_Automatic): Obsolete 1903 rimfire cartridge for Winchester Model 1903 rifle
- [.22 CB](https://grokipedia.com/page/.22_CB): Low-velocity subsonic .22 rimfire cartridge for quiet shooting

## Mythology & Linguistic Reconstruction

- [*Dyēus](https://grokipedia.com/page/*Dy%C4%93us): Proto-Indo-European sky father deity linguistic reconstruction
- [*Seh₂ul_ and _*Meh₁not](https://grokipedia.com/page/*Seh%E2%82%82ul_and_*Meh%E2%82%81not): Proto-Indo-European sun & moon deities reconstruction & mythology

## Music & Bands

- [...And You Will Know Us by the Trail of Dead](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_You_Will_Know_Us_by_the_Trail_of_Dead): Austin alternative rock band Trail of Dead history & discography
- [+44 (band)](https://grokipedia.com/page/+44_(band)): Blink-182 side project band by Mark Hoppus & Travis Barker (2005)
- [...Something to Be](https://grokipedia.com/page/...Something_to_Be): Rob Thomas debut solo album (2005) from Matchbox Twenty vocalist
- [...And I Return to Nothingness](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_I_Return_to_Nothingness): Lorna Shore 2021 deathcore EP featuring vocalist Will Ramos

## Classic Songs & Standards

- [(You Make Me Feel Like) A Natural Woman](https://grokipedia.com/page/(You_Make_Me_Feel_Like)_A_Natural_Woman): 1967 soul classic by Goffin-King recorded by Aretha Franklin
- [(Love Is) Thicker Than Water](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Love_Is)_Thicker_Than_Water): Andy Gibb 1977 #1 hit single co-written with Barry Gibb
- [(Up A) Lazy River](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Up_A)_Lazy_River): Hoagy Carmichael jazz standard from 1930 with Sidney Arodin

## Film & Entertainment

- [...And Justice for All (film)](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_Justice_for_All_(film)): 1979 Al Pacino legal drama directed by Norman Jewison overview

## Optional

- [(3-Aminopropyl)triethoxysilane](https://grokipedia.com/page/(3-Aminopropyl)triethoxysilane): APTES organosilicon compound used for surface modification
- [(153814) 2001 WN5](https://grokipedia.com/page/(153814)_2001_WN5): Potentially hazardous Apollo group near-Earth asteroid discovery
